name: Apophis Limited
source:
Desperate for debt relief, you take a job with the Apophis Limited Corporation, a telepathic communications company that wipes the memory of its employees after every shift for security purposes.

[From [url=https://ice-husky.itch.io/apophis-limited]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了摆脱沉重的债务，走投无路的你入职了“阿波菲斯有限公司”——一家出于安全保密考量，会在每次下班后抹除员工记忆的心灵感应通信企业。

[摘自[url=https://ice-husky.itch.io/apophis-limited]itch.io[/url]]
